text:
Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, the playlist can incorporate hip-hop elements that mirror the formation of pearls. Just as a pearl is created when an irritant is layered with nacre over time, the gritty atmosphere of city living can be represented through layered, complex beats and lyrical flows that build intensity. The relentless pace of urban life can be echoed by the driving rhythm of the hip-hop tracks, while the smooth, polished finish of a pearl can contrast with the raw, energetic energy of the city, creating a dynamic interplay between the harshness of the environment and the refined beauty of the art pieces.
